IAIAssistant.js driven port — outbound push

The app's outbound half of AI communication. PlannerContext calls notifyChange(planContext) fire-and-forget after every meaningful plan mutation. The adapter pushes the snapshot to the MCP server so Claude always has the latest plan state before any tool call. Currently built but not wired in config.js pending public MCP server hosting.

Parent
ports/
Direction
Driven (secondary) — app calls adapter. Contrast with IPlannerQuery + IPlannerAction (driving, inbound).

src/adapters/northeastern/aiAssistant.js

No-op stub — isAvailable() always returns false; notifyChange() is a no-op

Role in AI communication

IAIAssistant handles exactly one concern: pushing plan state from the app to the AI. The full AI loop uses three ports:

flowchart LR PC["PlannerContext\nplan changes"] AI_OUT["IAIAssistant\nnotifyChange()"] MCP["MCP server\nnumap://plan resource"] CL["Claude.ai\nSSE subscriber"] AI_IN_Q["IPlannerQuery\ntool calls (read)"] AI_IN_A["IPlannerAction\ntool calls (write)"] PC -->|"fire-and-forget after\nevery plan mutation"| AI_OUT AI_OUT -->|"POST /sync-plan/:sessionId"| MCP MCP -->|"resource update event"| CL CL -->|"read tools"| AI_IN_Q CL -->|"write tools"| AI_IN_A AI_IN_Q -->|"reads live state"| PC AI_IN_A -->|"dispatches actions"| PC style AI_OUT fill:#ffe4e6,stroke:#e11d48 style AI_IN_Q fill:#ddf4ff,stroke:#0969da style AI_IN_A fill:#ddf4ff,stroke:#0969da
IAIAssistant (red) is the proactive push — the planner notifies Claude whenever the plan changes. IPlannerQuery and IPlannerAction (blue) are the reactive pull — Claude reads and mutates the plan through MCP tool calls.

Keeping the outbound push (IAIAssistant) and the inbound read/write (IPlannerQuery, IPlannerAction) as three separate ports means each can evolve independently. An institution with no AI integration simply never wires IAIAssistant — the planner works identically, and IPlannerQuery/IPlannerAction can still be exposed to local tooling without a live AI client.

Interface

isAvailable()
() → boolean
Returns true if the adapter is configured and an AI client is currently connected. PlannerContext checks this before calling notifyChange() to avoid useless network round-trips. The NU adapter returns true when a session exists in localStorage and the SSE connection to the MCP server is live.
notifyChange(context)
(context: PlanContext) → void
Push the current plan state to the AI assistant. Called fire-and-forget — the app does not await a response. The adapter must never throw; it swallows and logs internally so a broken AI connection never disrupts the planner. PlanContext is defined in IPlannerQuery.js — the canonical plan snapshot type.
getSources()
() → SourceInfo[]
External systems this adapter communicates with. See IAttributable. The NU adapter reports the MCP server URL as a source.

NU implementation detail

The NU adapter in src/adapters/northeastern/aiAssistant.js works as follows:

  • Session management: A UUID session ID is created on first use and stored in localStorage under key "nu-map-mcp-session". This ID persists across browser reloads so Claude retains context across sessions.
  • Server URL: Read from VITE_MCP_SERVER_URL environment variable, defaulting to http://localhost:27182 for local development.
  • Endpoints:
    • GET /events/:sessionId — Server-Sent Events stream; adapter subscribes to detect when Claude connects/disconnects (drives isAvailable())
    • POST /sync-plan/:sessionId — Push plan snapshot; called by notifyChange()
    • POST /confirm-proposal/:sessionId/:proposalId — Confirm a pending propose() result after the user approves it in the UI
    • /session/:sessionId/mcp — MCP protocol endpoint for claude.ai integration

What triggers notifyChange()

PlannerContext calls notifyChange() after any mutation that changes visible plan state:

  • Course placed, moved, or removed
  • Work Experience (co-op/internship) added, moved, or removed
  • Major, concentration, or minor changed
  • Substitution or placed-out status changed
  • Bonus SH, SH override, or offering override changed
  • Entry/graduation semester or current semester marker changed
  • Active plan switched

Transient UI state (hover, drag, panel visibility, selected course) does NOT trigger notifyChange().

Adding an AI adapter for a different institution

To wire a different AI backend (or no AI at all), implement the three methods and pass the object as aiAssistant in your adapter's index.js. The no-op stub (always unavailable, no-op notifyChange) is the generic default — it requires no action if you don't want AI integration.

// src/adapters/myuniversity/aiAssistant.js
export default {
  isAvailable:  () => false,
  notifyChange: () => {},
  getSources:   () => [],
};
✦
Safety contract: notifyChange() must never throw. A broken or unresponsive AI server must not degrade the planner. The adapter is responsible for try/catch internally. PlannerContext assumes fire-and-forget semantics.
